infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Tether connects to your PC on your local network or Tailscale to control it.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tether uses the camera only to scan the pairing code shown on your computer.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Tether listens while you hold the talk button so your words can be dictated into the prompt. Audio never leaves your iPhone.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Tether turns your speech into text on this iPhone while you hold the talk button. Audio never leaves the device.
